hooks.command: [ -n "$TMUX" ] && name=$(tmux display-message -p '#W') && clean=$(printf '%s' "$name" | sed 's/^[⏸✓] //') && [ "$name" != "$clean" ] && tmux rename-window "$clean"; true
[ -n "$TMUX" ] && name=$(tmux display-message -p '#W') && clean=$(printf '%s' "$name" | sed 's/^[⏸✓] //') && tmux rename-window "⏸ $clean"; true
